business_problem: Growing connected-device demand increases the need for improved network capabilities. Mobily needed predictive and automated network management to identify network anomalies, optimize performance, and maintain reliable connectivity, including during critical and peak periods.
solution_summary: The deployed implementation is described as Ericsson’s AI-based network solution, delivered through the Ericsson Cognitive Software suite. Machine-learning models use multiple sources of data from Mobily’s live network to perform 5G network diagnostics, root-cause analysis, and recommendations. The release says the resulting automated diagnostics help Mobily identify network anomalies and resolve them through proactive network optimization; models learn from the live network and produce near-real-time improvements intended to avoid interruptions during critical and peak periods. The source does not name the underlying data sources, ingestion interfaces, compute or hosting services, storage systems, or operational integrations, so those architecture details cannot be specified. Its stated serving path is the delivery of diagnostics, recommendations, and network improvements into Mobily’s network operations, supporting reliable 5G connectivity and end-user experience.
